summary: Tested new NEWS 'Leer más' modal + Event photo support (admin image URL, event card image, event detail modal). Backend EventInput now accepts and persists optional 'image'. Frontend DetailModal opens for both news read-more and event card clicks with title/category/date/body and photo. Admin Eventos tab has a working image URL input.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx DetailModal is fine but Admin.jsx EventsTab silently swallows any create error (catch {} shows generic 'Failed' toast) — losing backend detail; consider surfacing err?.response?.data?.detail like CodesTab.
server.py is very large (18k+ lines). Not caused by this change, but worth splitting; the new EventInput.image change itself is clean.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo → admin token (ALLOW_DEMO_LOGIN=1 in backend/.env). Persist to localStorage as 'primal_token'.
seed_data_creation: During test: created TEST_ prefixed event with image=/dinos/carno.png, verified round-trip, then deleted. Also submitted TEST_UI_Evento via Admin UI (image=/dinos/rex.png) and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) POST /api/admin/events with image persists and round-trips via GET /api/events; (2) Dashboard event-card-N is clickable and opens data-testid=detail-modal with title/type badge/date_label/description and photo when available; (3) Events without image render a type icon banner in the modal (no broken img); (4) news-readmore-N opens the same modal with news title/category/timeAgo/body and image; (5) Close button (detail-modal-close) works; (6) Admin Eventos tab has data-testid=event-image input and adminCreateEvent submits with image. 5 events visible; first was 'Duelo Ápice' (no image → icon banner). News modal 'Mantenimiento del servidor completado' had 1 image and 153-char body. No console errors on dashboard/admin. Note: backdrop-click close finished slightly slower than the 700ms wait (AnimatePresence exit), but the close button reliably dismisses the modal; consider a shorter exit or explicit unmount if flaky.
